judul: Privacy protection strategies and recycling model selection of closed-loop supply chain considering consumer preferences
authors: Yang, Jianhua; Liu, Na; Xie, Wenqian; Zhai, Luyu
abstrak: Against the backdrop of frequent data breaches, consumers are increasingly concerned about privacy and information security when participating in recycling programs. This necessitates that e-waste recyclers enhance their privacy protection technologies. Addressing consumers? demand for privacy protection, this study constructs game-theoretic models of three dual-recycling modes under carbon cap-and-trade regulation. Through mathematical analysis and numerical simulation, we examine how factors like remanufacturing, carbon regulation, consumer behavior, and blockchain technology influence recyclers? investment decisions and manufacturers? recycling model selection. Key findings reveal that: the remanufactured product price show a positive correlation with emission reduction level, the eco-conscious consumer ratio, consumers? low-carbon awareness, and the acceptance of remanufactured goods. Under the three recycling models, the party with weaker channel convenience consistently offers higher recycling price but inferior privacy protection technologies compared to competitors. Consumers? perception of channel inconvenience differentially impacts entities across various recycling models. When the perceived inconvenience of the retailer?s channel is relatively low, the economic and environmental benefits are the greatest when both retailers and third parties are involved. When the cost of privacy protection is low, retailers and third parties can obtain more economic and environmental benefits by simultaneously introducing blockchain. This research enhances the understanding of privacy protection and blockchain technology within electronic product closed-loop supply chains, providing valuable insights to advance e-waste recycling initiatives and support the transition towards a low-carbon circular economy.

judul: Blockchain technology and the theory of the firm
authors: Varma, Nikhil; Carlos, Ferreira Joao; Surti, Chirag
abstrak: When is it cheaper to coordinate production inside a hierarchical firm rather than across an open market? As per the classical theory of the firm developed by Coase and Williamson, hierarchy wins in a low-trust, complex environment, as a hierarchical firm can economize on the cost of verifying, coordinating, and executing transactions. Blockchain technology upsets this calculus: it distributes the verification work that a central authority would otherwise perform and so changes the cost logic on which the classical prediction rests. This paper asks: how much is that difference? We build a simulation to evaluate four governance frameworks: traditional manual coordination without shared infrastructure, a centralized hub, a permissioned blockchain run by a subset of member firms, and a fully distributed blockchain. Each framework's coordination cost follows from an explicitly specified capacity structure, and every reported number can be regenerated from deposited code. Three findings stand out. First, digitization matters most in our model: all three digital arrangements improve on manual coordination, though this ordering and the size of the gap are set by our assumptions about manual effort. Second, distributed verification holds a real but bounded advantage over a centralized system, and it shrinks when the centralized alternative spreads its coordination load across several hubs (Sect. 4.9). Third, the advantage appears widest under a high complexity, low-trust environment, exactly where the classical theory expects hierarchy to perform best, a pattern that rests on assumptions we state openly and vary. Because our centralized arrangement carries hierarchy's congestion costs without its adaptive benefits, the results speak to one dimension of the classical question, the information-processing cost of coordination, and on that dimension only. Blockchain shifts the balance between markets and hierarchies; it does not overturn transaction cost economics.

judul: Designing a blockchain-enabled certification framework for food loss and waste reduction: a proof-of-concept in the fresh food supply chain
authors: Sainz, Nekane; Amador, Manuel; Alonso, Ainhoa
abstrak: Blockchain technology, supported by IoT, has proven essential for improving traceability in food supply chains, but its application to auditing and certifying food loss and waste (FLW) reduction remains largely unexplored. This paper addresses this gap by proposing the architectural design, data models, and audit workflow of a permissioned blockchain-enabled tool developed within the EU H2020 FOODRUS project. Focused on the Spanish fresh vegetable supply chain pilot, the proposed framework integrates Hyperledger Fabric to establish a decentralized and immutable ledger for recording audit evidence and verifying compliance indicators. Rather than assessing long-term operational impact, this study demonstrates the baseline technical feasibility of automating FLW certification workflows through a deployed proof-of-concept prototype. The implementation highlights key architectural contributions, such as standardized data schemas and an integrated 7-stage audit lifecycle, while identifying primary deployment hurdles, notably stakeholder reluctance toward ERP data sharing. The findings confirm that while a permissioned blockchain design effectively secures audit record integrity, broader adoption hinges on establishing legally recognized FLW certification schemes and granular data-governance mechanisms.

judul: Game theoretic modeling of blockchain?enabled dual-channel collection in closed-loop supply chains
authors: Sridhar, J.; Unnissa, M. Mubashir
abstrak: Blockchain technology has emerged as an innovative digital solution aimed at enhancing transparency, traceability, and trust within closed-loop supply chains, particularly in the domains of remanufacturing and recycling operations. This study formulates a Blockchain-enabled Closed-Loop Supply Chain model that incorporates an original equipment manufacturer $$(M-R)$$ , a retailer-third party $$(R-3p)$$ , and a manufacturer-third party $$(M-3P)$$ . In light of Blockchain investment costs, privacy concerns, information transparency, and competitive dynamics in recycling, a Stackelberg game framework is developed to analyze optimal pricing strategies, collection decisions, and overall profitability. The research investigates the impact of collection competition and Blockchain-related parameters on supply chain performance. Through numerical analysis and sensitivity assessments, the findings reveal that the adoption of Blockchain technology enhances acceptance rates for remanufactured products and influences channel decision-making, whereas intensified competition in collection efforts tends to diminish individual collection performance. The results indicate that the $$M-R$$ model exhibits superior economic performance, while the $$M-3P$$ model demonstrates greater recycling efficiency in the context of intense competition. This research contributes theoretical insights and practical guidance for the design of sustainable Closed-Loop Supply Chains through the strategic integration of blockchain technology and optimized recycling channel selection.

judul: Blockchain-enabled financing and sales format dynamic decision-makings in a low-carbon supply chain
authors: Fang, Haijie; Yu, Liying; Zhang, Ziyuan
abstrak: Blockchain technology (BT) can enhance the brand reputation of low-carbon products to increase the willingness of banks and core enterprises in capital-constrained low-carbon supply chains (CCLC-SC) to provide green loan. Therefore, this paper constructs bank and e-commerce platform green loan models with and without BT under both agency selling and reselling formats. By differential game, the optimal feedback dynamic equilibrium solutions of above models can be solved. Then, the optimal combination of green loan mode and sales format, which can improve economic performance and environmental performance is discussed from a long-term dynamic perspective of through comparison and analysis. The results reveal that BT will improve green loan amount, which increases as the impact of BT on brand reputation increases. Comparing the blockchain-enabled bank green loan mode and the blockchain-enabled e-commerce platform green loan mode respectively under two sales formats, when two loan interest rates are extremely low, the former mode can maximize the profit of the manufacturer but not the e-commerce platform. As two loan interest rate increases, the CCLC-SC can reach a consensus on the blockchain-enabled e-commerce platform green loan mode. Under relatively low commission rate, regardless of the blockchain-enabled green loan mode chosen by the manufacturer, the reselling format results in higher results. As the commission rate increases, the combination of blockchain-enabled e-commerce platform green loan mode and the agency selling format can achieve the optimal economic and environmental performance in CCLC-SC.

judul: Secure and scalable blockchain-enabled 5G vehicular networks using federated trust-aware sharding and cross-shard authentication
authors: Baig, Yaseen; Ahmed, Sajjad Waqar; Sangrasi, Arshad Hussain; Rahman, Fahad
abstrak: The rapid proliferation of fifth-generation (5G) vehicular networks requires massive connectivity and ultra-low-latency for intelligent transportation systems. While blockchain technology provides a promising decentralized foundation for data integrity and access control, existing vehicular blockchain frameworks remain limited in terms of scalability and lack integrated security mechanisms. In particular, heuristic sharding approaches such as Determinantal Point Process (DPP)-based partitioning improve throughput but ignore the trustworthiness of participating nodes and the security of cross-shard transactions. This paper proposes a Federated Trust-Aware Determinantal Point Process (FT-DPP) framework combined with a Cross-Shard Secure Transaction Channel (CS-STC) to achieve scalable and security-preserving consensus in 5G vehicular blockchains. The proposed FT-DPP integrates trust, communication quality, and transaction load into the sharding kernel, while a Proof-of-Trust (PoT) consensus assigns voting power according to node reputation. The CS-STC validates inter-shard transactions through zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP) bound to Merkle roots. Simulation and theoretical analysis indicate improved scalability, latency, and resistance to collusion compared with existing DPP-based and clustering schemes. Comprehensive simulations demonstrated that the proposed model improves shard load balance by up to 28% and reduces overall consensus delay by 20?25% compared with DPP-based and K-means benchmarks. Moreover, FT-DPP effectively lowers the attack success probability to below 5%, validating its robustness against Sybil and cross-shard spoofing attacks. The results indicated that integrating trust management with scalable sharding can provide a unified foundation for secure, efficient, and trustworthy 5G-enabled vehicular blockchains. The novelty of this work lies in introducing a trust-modulated DPP kernel that fundamentally alters the probabilistic selection behavior of shard formation. Unlike prior approaches that treat trust and diversity independently, the proposed FT-DPP integrates trust into the kernel structure itself, resulting in security-aware probabilistic selection with provable reduction in adversarial clustering.

judul: Distributed intrusion detection system based on blockchain and fog computing for IoT networks
authors: Trabelsi, Rahma; Fersi, Ghofrane; Jmaiel, Mohamed
abstrak: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a revolutionary technology that connects numerous smart devices, enabling them to communicate, gather, and share data. One of the most challenging aspects of IoT systems is ensuring security. In fact, saving IoT systems against malicious attacks has become a crucial necessity. The first step in preventing these attacks is to detect any intrusion that could lead to them. Automating this process is essential for greater efficiency. Existing Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) face a trade-off between accuracy and consumed resources. To bridge this gap, we present in this paper a novel approach for detecting intrusion in Internet of Things (IoT) devices by leveraging the synergistic capabilities of machine learning and blockchain technology, while exploiting the locality of fog nodes for low-latency processing. Our proposed method aims to improve the security and reliability of IoT systems. Each fog node in our system executes a hybrid IDS that uses a combination between signature-based, anomaly-based and reputation-based process employing machine learning algorithms to identify abnormal patterns indicative of malicious activity. Fog nodes engage in proactive collaboration to strengthen their shared knowledge base and improve the precision of intrusion detection mechanisms by collaboratively computing reputation scores that will serve for intrusion detection decision. The blockchain technology is used to ensure traceability, integrity, immutability, and post-hoc auditability of the scores that are used to decide to grant or revoke access. Blockchain is used as well to maintain the list of the trusted fog nodes that are allowed to participate in the reputation-score computation. The evaluation of the proposed solution is performed using different numbers of fog nodes ranging from 1 to 10 and various level of attack rates ranging from 30% to 90%. The experimental results have shown that the mean value of accuracy, precision, recall and f1-score are respectively 0.91, 0.95, 0.94 and 0.94, while maintaining false-positive rate less than 0.2. In the conducted zero-day tests, increasing the number of fog nodes from 1 to 10, improves the average of F1-score from 0.563 to 0.891, the recall from 0.557 to 0.915, and the accuracy from 0.574 to 0.896, proving the effectiveness of the collaborative approach in IoT networks.

judul: Blockchain and social pillar of ESG: a systematic review of real-world implementations and governance conditions
authors: Darkhawaja, Mohammed A. M.; Disli, Mustafa; Ali, Hassnian
abstrak: Blockchain technology is increasingly positioned as a digital infrastructure capable of advancing social sustainability objectives, yet systematic empirical evidence on its real-world social impacts remains fragmented and inconclusive. This study presents a systematic literature review with structured narrative synthesis of 79 empirical studies of blockchain implementations that have progressed beyond purely conceptual proposal, organized across four social ESG dimensions defined by the Refinitiv framework: community outcomes, human rights, product responsibility, and workforce development. The corpus is explicitly tiered by deployment maturity into operational systems, field pilots, controlled testbeds, and perception-based studies, and every outcome claim is qualified by the tier of evidence supporting it. All included studies are additionally subjected to a structured evidentiary appraisal covering deployment verifiability, outcome independence, comparison design, and full-text availability. Findings demonstrate that blockchain?s social ESG impacts are neither inherently positive nor negative, but are fundamentally contingent on governance design, institutional embedding, and stakeholder participation. Positive outcomes emerge consistently when blockchain augments existing social structures, preserves human deliberation, and is anchored in supportive institutional frameworks. Negative outcomes arise when automation displaces participation, implementations serve speculative rather than social purposes, or governance concentrates power among elite actors. A cross-cutting structural limitation is identified: blockchain resolves on-chain data integrity while leaving off-chain verification entirely unaddressed, constraining its accountability value across all domains. The review advances an evidence-based contingency framework specifying the conditions that govern blockchain?s social value and provides evidence-informed implications for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers seeking to distinguish genuine social impact from technological promise.

judul: Computational and blockchain-based threshold control of curing parameters in natural fibre and filler-reinforced biocomposites
authors: Priya, L.; Deepa, D.; Uvaraja, V. C.; Ramesh, G.
abstrak: With the aim of improving the mechanical and interfacial performance of natural fibre and filler-reinforced biocomposites, this work presents an integrated computational curing evaluation and blockchain-enabled traceability framework. The proposed system uses programmed conditional logic (if/if-else and break statements) to monitor curing temperature and duration against predefined threshold conditions, while blockchain technology provides a secure and immutable platform for recording curing parameters and process events. Blockchain-enabled Architectures 1 and 2 demonstrate consistent improvements in tensile, flexural, hardness, and interlaminar shear strength (ILSS) compared with conventional production. Under Architecture 2, the best-performing nanosilica composite achieves a tensile strength of approximately 150 MPa, hardness of 95?96 Shore-D, and ILSS of 32 MPa. Biochar-reinforced composites also exhibit improved mechanical performance. The observed improvements in fibre?matrix bonding and reduced data variation indicate the effectiveness of controlled curing. Overall, the study demonstrates a composite manufacturing framework that integrates blockchain-based traceability with threshold-based curing control to improve process consistency, reproducibility, and material performance.

judul: A blockchain-based traceable waste resource recycling and regeneration system with SFT rewards
authors: Liu, Ling-Chun; Chen, Chin-Ling; Deng, Yong-Yuan
abstrak: Large amounts of waste have caused serious damage to the global ecological environment, so there is an urgent need to develop innovative solutions. The blockchain Semi-Fungible Token (SFT) reward system for waste resource recovery and regeneration is a promising approach that combines blockchain technology and reward mechanisms to encourage participants to engage in waste recycling classification and regenerative manufacturing activities. The proposed scheme is based on blockchain technology and can ensure data security, traceability, and non-tamperability. Through smart contracts and cryptography, participants? contributions and activities can be confirmed, verified, and rewarded. Government oversight agencies play an essential role in the system, formulating policies and regulatory measures to ensure its fairness and effectiveness. Resource recyclers, conversion processors, and recycled manufacturers can participate in this system. The extent of their contribution and environmental impact will be assessed, quantified, and rewarded in cryptocurrency. This motivates participants to become more actively involved in waste recycling, sorting, and regenerative manufacturing, thereby promoting the protection and sustainable development of the global environment. The proposed scheme will help protect the environment, reduce the damage caused by waste to global ecosystems, and promote the development of a circular economy. At the same time, it also brings opportunities and benefits to participants, motivating them to participate more actively in waste recycling, classification, and regenerative manufacturing activities.

judul: Evolutionary Game Analysis of New-Energy Vehicle Supply Chain Financing: Using Blockchain under Dual-Credit Regulations
authors: Cao, Bin; Lin, Yaofeng; Zhong, Qing; Chen, Yu; Gong, Guanhua; Ou, Jinwen
abstrak: The implementation of dual-credit regulations in China has not only invigorated the business activities of power battery manufacturers on the supply side but also heightened the financing needs of those manufacturers that are at a disadvantage. Meanwhile, the emergence and development of blockchain technology have presented a novel and effective financing avenue for enterprises in the new-energy vehicle industry, a topic that has yet to be thoroughly explored in existing literature. To address this gap, we propose a new-energy vehicle supply chain finance model grounded in dynamic evolutionary game theory. This model specifically examines the interplay between dual-credit regulations and blockchain technology within a supply chain that comprises a capital-constrained power battery manufacturer and a vehicle manufacturer. We demonstrate that, propelled by the interplay between dual-credit regulations and blockchain technology, the stable equilibrium solution among the three parties is achieved when the financial institution integrates blockchain technology, the power battery manufacturer exhibits trustworthiness, and the vehicle manufacturer opts for repayment. We provide valuable insights into how to effectively address the imbalance in payoffs among supply chain participants and transition from a non-stable to a stable state for all three parties. This is achieved through the careful calibration of key model parameters, including a revenue incentive for the power battery manufacturer, a penalty for default loss for the vehicle manufacturer, the cost of information knowledge, and the magnitude of default loss.

judul: Blockchain-driven attribute-based searchable encryption: a comprehensive review
authors: He, Linjiong; Xiao, Meiyan; Li, Hongbo; Huang, Qiong
abstrak: With the development of smart devices and new technologies, the Internet of Things (IoT) has further accelerated the collection and transmission of data, resulting in a sharp expansion in the amount of data. Cloud computing offers a solution for storing and handling vast amounts of data; however, it also brings the challenge of data confidentiality, particularly in public cloud environments where the risk of data leakage is heightened. Attribute-based searchable encryption (ABSE) enables secure search and fine-grained access control in cloud environments. It supports both access control and secure search over encrypted data. However, traditional ABSE models depend on centralized authorities, which can lead to privacy risks. With its decentralized, transparent, and secure nature, blockchain technology effectively addresses these shortcomings. This paper begins by outlining several common system models and then focuses on the application of blockchain in ABSE, categorizing its roles into four areas: A) keyword search, B) serving as an authority, C) correctness and integrity verification, and D) other applications. Through a review of the literature, we summarize recent progress and propose potential future research directions.

judul: Secure cloud storage strategy of access control system using blockchain
authors: Rao, Lella Sridhara; Santhosh, Pokala; Satyanarayana, Dune; Latha, A.; Fariddin, Shaik Baba; Sowjanya, Ganugapati Naga
abstrak: Many applications are connected to the cloud nowadays, and user data is gathered globally and stored in cloud units. These storage companies function as untrustworthy third parties that handle data processing so that an organisation?s data can be sent, stored, and received. Numerous problems are faced, like high operating costs, poor data protection, and poor software quality. The existing methods rarely address resilience against sophisticated attack scenarios such as Sybil attacks, replay attacks, or collusion by malicious insiders. As a result, there is a need for a secure, scalable, and trustworthy access control framework that not only detects and prevents unauthorised access but also ensures immutability, accountability, and resilience against internal and external threats. This research seeks to address these gaps by proposing a blockchain-enabled layered architecture for secure cloud storage that applies access control to enhance the performance of the system. In this system, blockchain technology is integrated with cloud storage to enhance system performance. In this proposed system, the dataset is taken from CICIDS2017 (Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017), and after the data storage, users will communicate through the Cloud Service Interface for essential functions like network access, authority management, and overall security authentication. This system has a multi-layer authentication process like the blockchain?s edge layer, network layer, management layer, and cloud service interface. Because of this multi-layer authentication process, data will be more secure. Therefore, the proposed system improves storage capacity and security and minimizes communication cost, storage cost and execution time.

judul: A blockchain-enhanced CNN architecture for robust anomaly detection in industrial and IoT cyber-physical systems
authors: Anwar, Raja Waseem; Abrar, Mohammad; Salam, Abdu; Ullah, Faizan
abstrak: Cyber?physical and network attacks are becoming commonplace in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments, with the potential to disrupt operations, compromise safety, and potentially impact the reliability of security evidence. In this study, a modified CNN (mCNN) framework is proposed to detect anomalies with robust, auditable capabilities by incorporating blockchain technology. The detector is based on the following building blocks: dilated convolutions to capture temporal dependencies in industrial process data, multi-branch feature extraction, dataset-adaptive input structuring, and a compact classifier to model heterogeneous patterns in IoT traffic. Anomalies detected are turned into signed and hashed event records and sent to a permissioned Hyperledger Fabric workflow. They test the framework on SWaT and N-BaIoT and validate their results with three baselines: Isolation Forest, autoencoder, and LSTM, and compare them with accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC. The proposed CNN is designed under the adopted protocol, and the F1-scores obtained on SWaT and N-BaIoT are 0.977 and 0.951, respectively. abstrak: Abstract Organizations must integrate new technologies to build sustainable supply chains which depend on blockchain technology because circular economy practices are now being adopted worldwide and digital processes are rapidly evolving. This paper examines the operational and sustainability implications of blockchain technology adoption within remanufacturing supply chains by analyzing two distinct channel structures: the separated retail model (Model $$\varvec{S}$$ ) and the unified retail model (Model $$\varvec{U}$$ ). The developed framework uses two-stage Stackelberg game-theoretic structure which includes three elements to determine equilibrium values for pricing and demand and profit distribution. BCT improves consumer trust according to both symbolic and numerical analyses which demonstrate that BCT increases demand for remanufactured products when transparency benefits surpass privacy concerns. Sensitivity analysis results demonstrate that increased privacy concerns diminish the positive effects of transparency on demand and supply chain profitability. The BCT cost-sharing ratio variations mainly determine how profits are shared between the OEM and retailers while maintaining equilibrium prices and demand. The quantitative assessments demonstrate that Model $$\varvec{U}$$ produces total profit which exceeds Model $$\varvec{S}$$ by $$\varvec{102.55\%}$$ while it produces environmental effects which decrease by $$\varvec{73.28\%}$$ and it generates consumer benefits which exceed Model $$\varvec{S}$$ by $$\varvec{97.98\%}$$ in high transparency conditions. Model $$\varvec{S}$$ demonstrates better environmental performance while it generates consistent moderate revenue through remanufacturing during periods of low costs but Model U achieves better financial results and social sustainability through its centralized operation system. The research results demonstrate that equitable cost-sharing arrangements achieve critical importance while the research provides manufacturers and retailers with practical methods to implement blockchain technology for better profitability and sustainable growth. judul: Deep Kronecker NasNet-based AB-M Tree for Storage and Efficient Retrieval Model using Blockchain
authors: S.V.J, Mani; P, Vijayan; A, Ramachandran; K, Michael Mahesh
abstrak: Blockchain technology has gained significant attention in applications such as banking, digital copyright, healthcare, and secure data management due to its decentralization, traceability, and security capabilities. However, blockchain storage systems still suffer from high query latency, storage overhead, and scalability issues during transaction retrieval. To address these challenges, this work proposes a hybrid Deep Kronecker Neuron Attention Stage-by-Stage Net-enabled Adaptive Balanced Merkle tree (DKNasNet_AB-M tree) for improving blockchain storage scalability and retrieval efficiency. The developed DKNasNet_AB-M tree includes data, processing, and storage layers. The DKNasNet_AB-M stores every transaction within the data layer. The processing layer diminishes the storage requirement for each full node, and the proposed DKNasNet calculates the threshold. In the storage layer, a node reliability verification approach is employed for enhancing the full node stability and lessening the risk of inadequate data recovery. The experimental evaluation is conducted using Hyperledger Fabric V1.0.0 and V0.6 blockchain environments with Scalable and Efficient Chain (SE-Chain), Proof of Reliability (POR) chain, and Position chain (P-chain) projects under different node configurations and 2000 blockchain transactions. Moreover, metrics like query time, storage capacity, consensus overhead, fault tolerance, energy efficiency, throughput, and Retrieval Success Rate (RSR) are considered to estimate the efficiency of DKNasNet_AB-M tree, and the corresponding output of 35.49 ms, 23.33 MB, 0.333, 91.88%, 0.907, 9.174 Mbps, and 90.30% is achieved.

judul: Blockchain-enabled IoT security: a multi-layered framework for smart contract vulnerability detection and optimization
authors: Arora, Anjali; Aggarwal, Mayank
abstrak: The exponential expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) applications has raised critical issues about data security, integrity, and scalability, especially in IoT systems based on a centralized architecture. The decentralized and immutable nature of blockchain technology provides a compelling alternative; but smart contract (SC) security and efficiency is still a critical issue. This research presents a layered, pipeline-based approach for secure and efficient deployment of SCs, with IoT and decentralized storage. The framework integrates real-time IoT data collection, secure data pre-processing, SCs development, SCs vulnerability detection and gas optimization into a single system. To overcome storage constraints, the approach uses InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) for off-chain data storage, with on-chain hashes ensuring data integrity. The framework uses a multi-tool analysis to identify SC vulnerabilities and deploy and test them on the Sepolia Testnet. In addition to this, the framework adopts statistical validation methods such as Paired t-test (P?t Test), Kruskal?Wallis test(K-W Test) and Wilcoxon signed-rank test (WS-R Test) to assess the performance improvement and validate the effectiveness of the optimization approaches. Simulation-based testing results reveal that the proposed framework leads to lower gas usage, faster execution, and better security compared to conventional methods. The findings show that the proposed framework offers a scalable, secure, and efficient approach to design real-time IoT-based SC systems, which can be applied to environmental monitoring and smart city systems.

judul: Systematic analysis of peer to peer network attacks in blockchain technology examining strategies real world cases and cross layer vulnerabilities
authors: Kumar, Kuldeep; Dutta, Neha; Kumar, Vipin
abstrak: The peer-to-peer (P2P) network layer, the foundation of the system, tends to be underplayed in blockchain security conversations about headline-grabbing applications and consensus rules. This work digs deep into the P2P layer and discovers it to be a critical front for the integrity of the entire system, not passive plumbing for transactions. The complex realm of P2P attacks can be grouped into two main categories: those designed to destabilize network connections (such as Sybil, Eclipse, and BGP hijacking) and those aimed at destabilizing consensus (such as the infamous 51% attack and selfish mining). The mechanism, resource needs, and potential for pandemonium are utilized to classify each type of attack. To demonstrate that these are not merely hypothetical dangers, real-world catastrophes are analyzed, from the 2014 BGP hijacking of mining pools and the 2015 Bitcoin Eclipse attack to multiple attacks on Ethereum Classic. To better set up the ground to compare, such attacks are cataloged side by side in an easy-to-read comparative matrix. Forward-looking, the topic takes into account future threats, i.e., the growing threat of quantum attacks and the near-term threat of AI-based attacks. It also takes into account the sophisticated defenses needed to repel them, including zero-knowledge proofs and other privacy-enhancing measures. The aim is to put in the spotlight how securing the P2P layer and the expertise to build more secure blockchain systems is critical.

authors: Mohammed, Ismail Abdulatiff; Rusli, Mohd Ezanee; Yussof, Salman; Thabit, Reema
abstrak: Healthcare organizations use the combination of blockchain technology with Federated Learning to improve their data security and privacy protection systems. Research studies on FL and blockchain technology have increased in number yet only two Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) exist which examine their joint use in protecting medical patient information. To reduce this limitation, a PRISMA-based Systematic Literature Review (SLR) was conducted to synthesize evidence from 37 peer-reviewed studies focusing on blockchain-enabled federated learning for healthcare data privacy, security, and preservation. The survey presents its findings by showing how the combination of blockchain?s unchangeable record system with federated learning?s decentralized data processing methods protects patient information from both unauthorized access and data alteration and public record access threats. The review also discusses emerging encryption approaches reported in the literature, including XChaCha20, as a potential future direction for improving efficiency and scalability in privacypreserving healthcare systems. The combination of blockchain technology with FL enables to build trust between organizations while using encrypted patient information for training machine learning algorithms. The publication of research documents shows an increasing trend in the adoption of Blockchain-enabled FL (BFL) technology within the healthcare sector. This systematic review of BFL covers the topics of the BFL-related research, its pros and cons, and thus to help the security working on the development of security frameworks that focus on preservation. By providing a chart of current methods, pinpointing preservation problems, and describing future research directions such as XChaCha20 integration, the SLR gives practicable hints for secure, preservationcentric healthcare systems. The findings indicate that the integration of blockchain and federated learning offers significant potential for secure and privacy-preserving healthcare data management. Furthermore, emerging encryption approaches such as XChaCha20 may represent promising directions for future research, although additional empirical validation is required.

judul: Drivers of blockchain-enabled smart contract adoption in infrastructure public?private partnerships projects: an international experts survey
authors: Eze, Emmanuel Chidiebere; Ameyaw, Ernest Effah
abstrak: The public?private partnership (PPP) remains the most widely used approach in procuring infrastructure projects. However, owing to the increasing numbers of failures, terminations and re-municipalisation recorded in both ?PPP mature and maturing markets? of the world, the level of investments in infrastructure PPP projects has declined. The lack of trust and transparency, poor contract compliance, inferior quality, and payment enforcement, among other issues, have been blamed for the failures/terminations of PPP projects. Furthermore, the predominance of traditional, paper-based contracting techniques in PPP arrangements, combined with the lack of automation processes and modern transformative technologies, such as blockchain and smart contracts, has worsened the situation. Blockchain technology and smart contracts can mitigate some of the issues contributing to the underperformance of PPP projects. The purpose of this study was to critically evaluate the drivers of blockchain-enabled smart contracts (BSC) adoption and implementation in long-term infrastructure projects delivered under the PPP route. A hybrid model of the TOE framework and institutional theory was adopted to guide the decision to implement smart contracts in PPP projects. The structured questionnaire was used to gather relevant data from international experts via the snowball sampling technique. With a reliability index of over 0.800, the data were analysed using the mean score, coefficient of variation (CV), Kendall test of concordance, and partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). A high level of agreement was found among respondents regarding the assessed factors. Furthermore, technological drivers and coercive pressure substantially influence the decision to implement BSC in infrastructure PPP projects. Then, economic, organisational, normative, and mimetic pressures are considered in order of their contribution to the decision of the public and private sector partners to adopt smart contracts in the delivery of long-term infrastructure PPP projects.

authors: Siripuri, Kiran; Vuppula, Roopa; Aluvalu, Rajanikanth; Mallellu, Sai Prashanth; Rao, Duggineni Srinivasa

The approach has been perceived as a viable measure of resolving energy inefficiency and scarcity of the spectrum in the future wireless communication networks. Nevertheless, sharing of resources and services in SWC places has not been an easy task because of untrustworthy trust systems across diverse platforms. To deal with this challenge, this paper will present a symbiotic blockchain wireless network (SBWN) which will combine blockchain technology and SWC to provide safe and effective communication. The framework proposed makes use of cognitive backscatter communication and energy-efficient sharding mechanism to minimize the processing overhead and improve system performance. The simulation results show that SBWN ensures up to 60% of energy efficiency, almost 19% higher packet delivery ratio, almost 80 percent reduced latency, and around 88% enhanced throughput over traditional baseline techniques. judul: A deep learning and blockchain enabled adaptive routing framework for secure Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
authors: Oli, Jayashree M.; Neelima, N.; Vasquez, Juan C.; Bahadur, Jitendra
abstrak: Vehicular Ad hoc Networks (VANETs) are one of the most important enablers of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSs), however, their dynamic topologies and susceptibility to malicious activities provide a serious challenge to the routing efficiency and security. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a new Deep Learning-based Adaptive Routing with Blockchain-enabled Trust Management (DL-ARBTM) mechanism that incorporates two mutually complementary stages. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is used during the adaptive routing phase, where the routing process is modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), and the vehicles at the routing node are autonomous agents, which monitor the quality of links, mobility of nodes and the density of items to decide the best next-hop node dynamically. An Actor-Critic agent guarantees efficient policy learning and stabilizing in highly dynamic environments. During the trust management stage, blockchain technology with Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT) consensus has an immutable distributed registry of node trust scores that allow decentralized checks on forwarding behavior, key exchange, and efficient mitigation of Sybil, packet dropping, and misinformation attacks. The two-layered integration guarantees that DRL chooses routes based on nodes that are trusted and therefore improves reliability and resiliency. Unlike existing VANET routing solutions that treat adaptability and security independently, the proposed DL-ARBTM uniquely integrates actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with blockchain-based decentralized trust management. This joint design enables trust-aware adaptive routing, achieving higher packet delivery ratio, throughput, and trust accuracy with lower end-to-end delay compared to AODV, GPSR, Q-learning, and blockchain-only approaches, thereby advancing secure and scalable ITS communications.

judul: Hybrid Intelligence in Blockchain: Toward a Unified Model of AI-Enhanced Smart Contracts
authors: Saleem, Malaika; Rasool, Hafiza Asma; Qureshi, Junaid Nasir; Shaheen, Momina; Elkiran, Harun; Rasheed, Jawad
abstrak: Blockchain technology and artificial intelligence (AI) were introduced and integrated to develop new possibilities for security, automation, and transparency in digital financial ecosystems. This study proposes a hybrid AI Blockchain framework for automated credit evaluation and identity tokenization, addressing issues with opacity, bias, and data manipulation that affect conventional, centralized credit scoring systems. To predict client creditworthiness from past financial behavior, we trained several supervised machine learning models on the UCI Default of Credit Card Clients dataset. These models included Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM, KNN, and Gradient Boosting. Support Vector Machine (SVM) outperformed the others in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Their performance metrics ranged between 0.841?0.915 for accuracy, 0.830?0.902 for precision, 0.828?0.900 for recall, and 0.829?0.901 for F1-score. Among all models evaluated, the Random Forest (RF) classifier performed best, achieving an accuracy of 0.907, a precision of 0.895, a recall of 0.894, and an F1-score of 0.895. Ensemble methods, however, achieved higher scores overall; among all seven classifiers, XGBoost obtained the highest raw accuracy (0.915), while Random Forest (RF) was selected as the deployed model, achieving an accuracy of 0.907, a precision of 0.895, a recall of 0.894, and an F1-score of 0.895. Random Forest was preferred over both SVM and XGBoost for production integration because it combined near-top predictive performance with substantially lower training/inference latency, native feature-importance interpretability, and simpler on-chain integration properties that matter for a system whose decisions must be auditable and re-verifiable. RF demonstrated an excellent balance of predictive accuracy, generalization, robustness to overfitting, and interpretability, making it the optimal choice for deployment in the blockchain ecosystem. The Random Forest model?s decisions were integrated into an Ethereum-based smart contract, which issues non-transferable identity tokens to qualified users and permanently records loan approval results. By providing verifiable audit trails, tamper resistance, and transparency, this blockchain layer increases confidence in decentralized financial (DeFi) services. Experimental findings confirm the hybrid architecture?s sustainability, scalability, and dependability. These findings focus on model accuracy and on-chain execution cost; broader claims about fairness and governance impact are discussed as architectural potential rather than measured outcomes. According to the study, AI-enhanced smart contracts can significantly enhance the security, accountability, and fairness of financial decision-making while providing a framework for future applications in supply chain management, healthcare, and decentralized identity management. Consistent with the scope described above, the fairness and governance benefits discussed here reflect the architecture?s design potential rather than experimentally demonstrated outcomes.

judul: Blockchain-based distributed federated learning using proof of accuracy consensus
authors: Sadegh, Aghil; Bidgoly, Amir Jalaly
abstrak: This paper explores integrating federated learning (FL) and blockchain technology, two burgeoning fields in information technology. Despite their growing popularity, both domains face significant challenges. In federated learning, the primary concern is safeguarding the integrity of the general model against client-induced compromises. Blockchain technology grapples with the need for a green mining approach through an energy-efficient consensus protocol. Our study leverages the strengths of each platform to mitigate the weaknesses of the other. We introduce an innovative blockchain-based FL model that eliminates the need for a central aggregator. Utilizing a green mining consensus algorithm named Proof of Accuracy (PoAcc), we create a competitive environment among nodes, fostering the creation of superior models. This approach ensures data integrity and model validation through a community-based consensus, resulting in a fully distributed system. This system enhances FL?s security and scalability and addresses vulnerabilities like malicious aggregators and scalability issues. Through experimental evaluations on the MNIST dataset with 20 miners, on one hand, our method enhances model accuracy to nearly 99% only after 10 blocks, which is a higher point compared to FL and central learning. On the other hand, replacing Proof of Work (PoW) with PoAcc reduces energy consumption by nearly 30%. Moreover, blockchain attacks appeared to be inapplicable or resolvable after 6 blocks, like fork attacks. After all, the introduced incentivizing mechanism lets malicious nodes get nearly zero rewards and allocates main rewards to honest nodes, which is coherent with their efforts to present a superior model.

judul: Examining Customers? Readiness to Adopt E-commerce Services Based on Blockchain
authors: Trpkov, Aleksandra; Sovtic, Danica; Radenkovic, Milo?; Popovic, Sne?ana; Labus, Aleksandra
abstrak: E-commerce is a rapidly growing industry that stands to gain the most from emerging technologies. Online shopping and trading have become the preferred activities for customers and other stakeholders in the e-commerce value chain. The primary issues stakeholders face include trust, secure payments, transaction costs, and transparency in supply chains and financial transactions. Blockchain technology has the potential to solve all of these issues, providing a robust framework for a more secure and efficient e-commerce ecosystem. This research delves into the potential applications of blockchain in e-commerce and presents a new model of an e-commerce ecosystem based on blockchain. In addition, a survey was conducted to gauge customers? readiness to adopt blockchain-based e-commerce services. The acceptance study used the UTAUT2 model, and data analysis was performed with SmartPLS. The study results suggest that blockchain significantly enhances consumer trust and satisfaction. Furthermore, the analysis revealed that the statistically significant variables affecting the adoption of blockchain in e-commerce are Effort expectancy, Perceived efficiency, Price value, and Trust. It is crucial to educate individuals about the effort and trust required when implementing new technologies. The research provides a theoretical contribution by refining the UTAUT2 model and proposing a blockchain-based e-commerce ecosystem model. Its practical implications offer businesses and policymakers strategies to enhance trust, improve usability, and establish regulatory clarity for real-world blockchain adoption.

judul: Blockchain-Enhanced Corporate Governance: A Meta-synthesis Framework for private Sector
authors: Mohammadpoor, Habib; Jooshati, Hojjat Ghadri; Aghamohamadi, Ahdieh
abstrak: This meta-synthesis examines how blockchain technology reshapes corporate governance across private sector firms through a systematic analysis of 42 qualitative and mixed-method studies published between 2016 and 2025. Through a systematic and rigorous literature synthesis, 15 main categories across corporate governance dimensions were identified, providing a comprehensive framework for organizational analysis. The findings reveal a temporal evolution in two phases: foundational trust mechanisms and operational implementation (2016?2022), and critical evaluation revealing unintended consequences (2023?2025). The analysis uncovers several critical paradoxes challenging blockchain governance assumptions, such as the transparency paradox (42% increase in greenwashing despite enhanced ESG disclosure), Decentralization Paradox (centralized hybrid structures outperforming purely decentralized models by 37%), and DAO Governance Paradox (65% token concentration among top holders with < 10% participation rates). This study introduces the Blockchain-Enhanced Corporate Governance Framework (BECGF), synthesizing Agency Theory, Stewardship Theory, and Transaction Cost Economics to explain blockchain?s dual role as both a governance solution and source of new challenges. We identify critical boundary conditions that determine implementation success, including organizational readiness, regulatory environments, and stakeholder digital literacy. The results demonstrate that blockchain?s transformative potential is contingent rather than universal, requiring a careful assessment of contextual factors and potential paradoxical outcomes. This synthesis advances the theoretical understanding by revealing the paradoxical nature of blockchain governance mechanisms and provides practitioners with an evidence-based framework for navigating implementation complexities in private sector contexts.

judul: Blockchain Adoption Strategy in E-commerce Supply Chain with Competing Retailers
authors: Huang, Jinting; Yan, Xiangbin
abstrak: Generally, it is difficult for consumers to accurately authenticate the product information disclosed by online e-commerce platforms in traditional e-commerce supply chain. Therefore, due to the information immutability and traceability of blockchain technology, blockchain has become an important tool for consumers to judge product information. To analyze the application strategies of blockchain technology, we construct Stackelberg game model in an e-commerce supply chain, consisting of one supplier and two retailers, and explore blockchain adoption strategies from the perspectives of supply chain competition. First, we indicate the equilibrium results of product price, the supplier and retailers profits and consumer surplus, and show the accuracy of consumers quality judgement on the products produced by the supplier always has a positive impact. Furthermore, we discuss the optimal strategies with blockchain technology effect and find retailers competition and consumers quality judgement on the products would impact blockchain adoption decisions and the profits of the whole supply chain. It indicates that retailers different blockchain technology implement decisions are beneficial to the social welfare of the whole supply chain. Finally, we analyze the impact of blockchain technology on optimal decision-making and consumers judgment of product information. And we find that when the proportion of expert consumers in the supply chain is high, the supplier prefers to improve product quality management capability and retailers would apply blockchain technology. The main contribution of this study is to combine the analysis of blockchain implement with different consumers judgement in competitive e-commerce supply chain, which reveals the value of blockchain technology service, transaction modes and retailers competitive relationship in supply chain.

judul: Thermal characterization and calorimetric analysis of millimeter-wave and terahertz communication device materials: a blockchain-secured data management approach
authors: Jose Reena, K.; Virdee, Bal; Khanna, Ashish; Siva Shankar, S.; Aroul Canessane, R.
abstrak: Thermal characterization and calorimetric analysis are techniques used to evaluate heat absorption, heat transfer, and thermal stability of materials to ensure reliable performance in advanced millimeter-wave (mmWave) and terahertz (THz) communication devices. However, materials used in these high-frequency communication devices experience significant thermal stress, requiring detailed investigation of their thermal behavior and stability. This research presents a thermal characterization and calorimetric analysis framework for materials employed in mmWave and THz communication devices, integrated with a blockchain-secured data management approach. The dataset contains 5470 thermal measurement records, including temperature response, heat absorption, thermal conductivity, specific heat capacity, and material stability parameters. Min?Max normalization is applied during preprocessing to standardize thermal features and improve analytical accuracy. Wavelet transform is employed for feature extraction to capture temperature variation patterns and heat-response characteristics across different material conditions. Furthermore, an Elephant Clan mutated Enriched Support Vector Regression model is utilized to predict thermal performance, where Elephant Clan optimization improves parameter tuning and Enriched Support Vector Regression enhances prediction precision. Blockchain technology is integrated to provide secure storage, decentralized access control, transparent sharing, and immutable recording of thermal experimental data. Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance and Reliable, Replicated, and Fault-Tolerant consensus mechanisms are used to ensure secure and reliable agreement among distributed data nodes. Simulation results implemented in Python demonstrate efficient heat dissipation, improved thermal stability (165 °C and 290 °C), and peak heat absorption of 80 W/m^2, supporting reliable thermal performance for mmWave and THz communication devices.

judul: Blockchain research in accounting and auditing through bibliometric and science mapping analysis
authors: Tahat, Yasean; Benhayoun, Issam; Zejjari, Ibtissam; AlMi?ani, Muder; Hassanein, Ahmed
abstrak: Blockchain technology is increasingly reshaping industrial and organizational processes through its capacity to enhance transparency, traceability, automation, and data integrity. Within accounting and auditing, blockchain has emerged as a disruptive digital infrastructure capable of transforming financial reporting, assurance practices, governance mechanisms, and sustainability-related disclosure systems. Despite rapidly growing scholarly attention, the intellectual structure, interdisciplinary evolution, and emerging trajectories of blockchain research in accounting and auditing remain fragmented and insufficiently mapped. This study addresses this gap through a large-scale scientometric analysis of 322 peer-reviewed publications indexed in Scopus between 2017 and 2024. Using Bibliometrix and VOSviewer, the study examines publication and citation trends, leading authors, journals, institutions, and countries, international collaboration patterns, keyword co-occurrence networks, and the major thematic clusters represented in the literature. The findings reveal a rapidly expanding and globally interconnected research domain characterized by four dominant thematic areas: blockchain adoption in accounting and auditing, the impact of blockchain adoption on accounting and auditing practices, blockchain-enabled sustainability and governance, and the future integration of blockchain with artificial intelligence, Industry 4.0, and data-driven auditing environments. The analysis further identifies emerging research frontiers related to digital governance, continuous auditing, cybersecurity, intelligent supply chains, and technology-enabled accountability systems. The study contributes by providing a comprehensive computational overview of blockchain-enabled accounting ecosystems and by identifying critical knowledge gaps, interdisciplinary linkages, and future research directions relevant to researchers, regulators, audit firms, and technology-driven organizations. The findings highlight blockchain?s growing role as a foundational infrastructure for next-generation industrial and financial information systems.

judul: Optimizing Supply Chain Finance Through Blockchain Technology: A Sustainability-Integrated Dual-Channel Closed-Loop Model
authors: Hasheminezhad, Sara; Hosseini, Monireh; Babaei, Ardavan
abstrak: In this paper, we present an innovative optimization framework based on Stackelberg game theory, in which blockchain technology is integrated with dual-channel closed-loop supply chain finance and internal sustainability investments. Although previous studies have discussed blockchain, supply chain finance, and sustainability independently, we explore the interactive relationships among these three aspects in a three-tier system: producer, bank, and distributor. Two comparative models are developed for both traditional and blockchain-enabled closed-loop supply chain finance system analysis. We consider sustainability investment as an endogenous factor to affect demands, financing rates, and recycling incentives using a transparency parameter to improve credibility. Equilibrium solutions are obtained by backward induction in the framework of the Stackelberg game. As indicated by our numerical examples, blockchain technology improves transparency and simultaneously reduces the financing cost and affects recycling incentives and circular-economy performance, with considerable improvements in total chain profit over all operational scenarios. The performance of the blockchain-enabled model always outperforms the traditional system in terms of profitability, return on environmental investment, and circular economy performance. Our comprehensive sensitivity analyses also confirm the robustness of our model under variations in market conditions, financing costs, and sustainability parameters. Based on this research, we can achieve a win?win situation for all players, and this is the first combined operational research model that integrates blockchain technology with sustainable closed-loop supply chain finance. This can provide practical insights for green financial platform design that aligns economic objectives with environmental stewardship.

judul: PQMDSBS: Post-quantum multivariate digital signature-based blockchain security scheme for mobile edge IoT applications
authors: Rajappa, R. Thenmozhi; Periyasamy, P. Sakthivel; Kanagasabai, K. Kulothungan
abstrak: Integration of Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge Computing (EC) presents significant challenges, particularly in guaranteeing secure communication amid IoT devices and cloud systems formerly to data aggregation. Existing aggregation schemes often compromise on cost-effectiveness while struggling to preserve data integrity and confidentiality in face of emerging quantum computing threats. In response to the rising demand for robust security protocols, Post-Quantum (PQ) cryptography, particularly Multi-Variate Digital Signature (MVDS) has become increasingly significant in Public Key (PK) cryptosystems. This paper presents an MVDS-based aggregate signature scheme that efficiently consolidates multiple signatures into a single, verifiable cryptographic signature, enhancing both security and performance. The proposed scheme is specifically designed for mobile edge-based IoT applications and utilizes blockchain technology to assurance of secure and transparent data storage. Comprehensive security analyses reveal that this mechanism offers superior resistance to quantum attacks while improving efficiency when compared to existing benchmarked approaches. Additionally, simulations conducted using NS3 and blockchain frameworks establish effectiveness of the propounded scheme in maintaining data integrity and authenticity in a quantum-resistant manner. This work represents a significant advancement in securing IoT environments from emerging digital threats.

judul: Enhancing security in IoT consumer electronics through hybrid encryption and blockchain technology
authors: Aluvalu, Rajanikanth; KMVV, Prasad; Maheswari, Uma, V; Mallellu, SaiPrashanth; Tejani, Ghanshyam G.; J, Seyed
abstrak: Ensuring the safety of internet-connected Consumer Electronics has become a top priority in home automation industry due to the growing number of devices connected to the Internet and Consumer Electronics market. There are loopholes in wireless security that allow bad actors to access private data, compromise network security, and abuse sensitive information in IoT frameworks. This paper presents SHOA, a new encryption strategy that combines the Noekeon-based hybrid encryption approach with the RSA encryption methodology, to address these issues. The security of the system is strengthened using this dual encryption approach. Moreover, blockchain integration allows for safe distribution of encrypted data. In addition, this work introduces a modified B+tree-based method that uses the Sea Horse Optimization Algorithm (SHOA), a portable query technique that is tuned for quick decryption of encrypted data, to get key value. By comparing the SHOA scheme to current approaches, it can be observed that the proposed method improves security of wirelessly linked IoT CE and reduces vulnerabilities; hence, it provides a durable solution to the security problems that plague IoT today.

judul: Social craft beer and blockchain technology: Italian consumers? preferences
authors: Palmieri, Nadia; Boccia, Flavio
abstrak: Public comprehension of blockchain technology, especially concerning its societal implications, is a relatively underexplored area. This study seeks to fill this void by investigating how such technological advancements might influence consumer purchasing decisions. Specifically, it examines whether individuals are inclined to buy ?social? craft beers (produced by social farms) that offer transparent details regarding their origin, social aspects (including the involvement of women who have experienced domestic violence in production), and processing techniques. To achieve these findings, a survey based on a modified Technology Acceptance Model within the Italian context was carried out. The results demonstrate that information on the origin of craft beer, its social impacts and processing methods should provide reciprocal advantages among Italian consumers and social farms. In this sense, blockchain would be a useful tool to generate knowledge both to support the economic inclusion of female victims of domestic violence, and to improve social farms contexts. In other words, blockchain technology should offer transparent information regarding the origin of beer, its social aspects (supporting women economic inclusion) and processing techniques, thereby providing the end consumer with a high-quality product.

judul: The Impact of Blockchain Technology Adoption on Sustainability Performance: A Sectoral Analysis
authors: Gaisina, Albina; Dogan, Burak; Teklie, Derese Kebede
abstrak: This study examines whether blockchain technology adoption improves corporate sustainability performance and whether its effects differ across sectors. Using a panel of 491 S&P 500 firms from 2015 to 2023, blockchain adoption is identified through natural language processing of 10-K filings, while sustainability is measured using Bloomberg ESG scores and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions intensity. A staggered difference-in-differences framework with firm and year fixed effects is employed, alongside sectoral interaction models and robustness checks. The findings show no evidence that blockchain adoption enhances overall ESG performance. Across multiple specifications, blockchain disclosure is not significantly associated with higher composite ESG scores. At the pillar level, no effect is found for environmental performance, the social dimension shows weak negative tendencies, and governance exhibits only a marginally positive relationship. In contrast, blockchain adoption is associated with higher GHG emissions intensity. Sectoral results do not support stronger positive effects in digitally intensive industries. Instead, some sectors show negative associations. Overall, the results suggest that blockchain disclosure may reflect technological signaling rather than measurable sustainability improvements. Moreover, such disclosure may not accurately capture the adoption and reflect the depth or maturity of actual blockchain implementation.

judul: Faculty acceptance of blockchain technology in higher education: an extended technology acceptance model analysis
authors: Abouelenein, Yousri Attia Mohamed; Khalaf, Mohamed Hassan Ragab; Ghazala, Ayat Fawzy Ahmed; Mahdy, Eman Mahdy Mohamed
abstrak: Blockchain technology possesses transformative potential across various industries, including higher education, offering improved security, transparency, and efficiency in managing academic records and certification. This study employed an Extended Technology Acceptance Model (ETAM) to examine faculty acceptance of blockchain technology in higher education and inform implementation strategies. A survey instrument based on the ETAM framework was administered to 297 faculty members across some countries in the Middle East. The results indicated generally favorable perceptions of blockchain technology. Regression analyses revealed that both perceived usefulness (ß = 0.54, p < .001) and perceived ease of use (ß = 0.48, p < .001) significantly predicted faculty intention to adopt the technology. Further analyses identified significant differences in blockchain perceptions based on academic specialty, with science faculty reporting higher perceptions compared to humanities faculty (t(297) = 2.005, p = .046), attitudes toward using blockchain technology (t(297) = 3.161, p = .002), and total blockchain technology in education (BTE) (t(297) = 3.050, p = .002). There were also significant differences observed in the perceptions of faculty members based on their geographical context, showing considerable differences (t(297) = 4.206, p < .001). These findings underscore the importance of implementation strategies designed for academic specialization and geographic context. Perceived usefulness and ease of use remain critical drivers of technology acceptance in higher education, highlighting the need for targeted resources and support to facilitate successful integration. However, the study?s cross-sectional design and exclusive focus on faculty perspectives provide a circumscribed view of implementation complexities and long-term impacts. Future research should incorporate longitudinal data, including student perspectives, and assess technical and organizational readiness. This study also invites further exploration of the impact of targeted training on faculty acceptance and on discipline-specific blockchain use.

judul: Data-Driven Robust Optimization for a Sustainable Drug Supply Chain Using Blockchain and Solar-Powered Vehicles
authors: Mohammadi-Kordkheili, Behrouz; Sahraeian, Rashed
abstrak: Pharmaceutical logistics focuses primarily on cost and individual health, while environmental and social aspects are often overlooked. Although electric vehicles reduce pollution in drug delivery, they also create new challenges such as congestion at charging stations and increased electricity demand. Additionally, the lack of drug tracking systems and the risk of data manipulation by fraudsters introduce further complications in this supply chain. To address these issues, this paper proposes a sustainable drug supply chain incorporating blockchain technology and solar-powered vehicles. The number of blocks in the blockchain and transactions are determined based on the medicines transferred and their recording times. Both solar-powered and conventional vehicles are employed to transport medical goods. The weather conditions and shading affect solar energy harvesting. The distribution centers are considered as home healthcare centers, ensuring timely delivery of medical items. Moreover, this paper considers demand under uncertainty. To deal with this, a data-driven robust optimization model (DDROM) is proposed, which uses support vector clustering to construct the uncertainty set. The augmented $$\varepsilon$$ -constraint method is applied to compare the DDROM with the box-polyhedral robust model. The results demonstrate that the DDROM outperforms the Box-polyhedral model based on the mean ideal distance and spread of non-dominance solution metrics. Furthermore, by converting the multi-objective functions into a single-objective function, the robustness of the DDROM is examined under varying conservatism coefficients and scenario realizations. As the conservatism coefficient increases, the uncertainty set expands, leading to more conservative solutions. Finally, a sensitivity analysis is performed on the blockchain memory size, showing that the model?s responses align with the expected behavior.

judul: Mining for efficiency: how blockchain could boost productivity in Chile?s copper industry
authors: Ríos, Francisco; Peña, Camilo; Agnese, Pablo
abstrak: This paper explores the potential impact of blockchain technology on the productivity of Chile?s copper mining industry. Amid rising global demand for copper and declining mining productivity, Chile faces challenges which include complex contractor management and administrative inefficiencies. We review the recent trends in mining productivity and blockchain technology and conduct a preliminary survey to assess the status of blockchain adoption in Chile?s mining industry. The study also explored the impact of smart contracts in Chile?s mining sector by analyzing contracts information of a large mining company in Chile. Our results suggest that high-impact projects in Chile?s mining industry could benefit from integrating blockchain technology. However, these benefits will likely be concentrated among larger projects and contracts, where the costs of implementation and maintenance could be justified by the potential benefits. An exploratory survey on a selected group of senior professionals and executives shows most of respondents do not know the blockchain, and a small fraction of them are barely implementing it. Adoption barriers include limited internal capabilities, implementation challenges, resistance to change, procedural culture, and uncertain financial returns. In spite of these challenges, smart contracts are viewed as highly important for the organization. Our findings also suggest that blockchain could improve transparency, supply chain, reduce accreditation times, and streamline compliance in large-scale operations. A single-site analysis shows modest economic gains (USD 5.6 million NPV) but high returns (~ 2,300% ROI), indicating viability for low-risk implementation. Finally, our study concludes that blockchain offers incremental but valuable improvements, helping Chile?s mining sector enhance efficiency and competitiveness in a rapidly evolving global market. Our contribution is of an exploratory nature, and further research in the direction of designing a model is part of our broader research agenda.

judul: Blockchain in supply chain management: a comprehensive review of success measurement methods
authors: Hübschke, Marc; Buss, Eugen; Holschbach, Elmar; Lier, Stefan
abstrak: Research on blockchain technology in supply chain management has gained significant attention in recent years due to its potential to address critical challenges such as transparency, traceability, and operational efficiency. Despite this interest, the relationship between blockchain implementation and its measurable success has not been thoroughly investigated. This study conducts a systematic literature review of 46 peer-reviewed papers published between 2008 and 2024, synthesizing current research on how blockchain performance is assessed within supply chains. By categorizing the findings across key success factors, research methodologies, and performance indicators, this study provides a structured understanding of blockchain?s role in SCM. Emerging from our review, we develop a dynamic evaluation framework that systematically integrates use cases, objectives, input criteria, research methodologies, and expected outcomes, illustrating their interdependencies. This framework demonstrates blockchain?s capacity to enhance supply chain performance through improved transparency, enhanced traceability, and strengthened sustainability practices. Furthermore, it provides a structured approach to assessing blockchain?s long-term viability, emphasizing its iterative nature, which allows organizations to refine and adapt their implementations in response to evolving business and regulatory landscapes. Our findings underscore the cross-industry applicability of blockchain technology, spanning various sectors and bridging both operational and strategic objectives. However, the analysis reveals significant research gaps, particularly in empirical studies validating blockchain?s long-term impact on supply chain resilience, sustainability, and multi-stakeholder collaboration. Additionally, inconsistencies in performance measurement approaches hinder the comparability of findings across studies. Addressing these gaps through future research will be essential to fully unlocking blockchain?s transformative potential in SCM and ensuring its effective integration into global supply chain ecosystems.

judul: Digital technology based game-theoretic pricing strategies in a three-tier perishable food supply chain
authors: Dey, Sushil Kumar; Kundu, Kaustav; Das, Prasun
abstrak: The purpose of this study is to examine the pricing strategies of a three-tier supply chain for perishable food products, which includes the manufacturer, distributor, and retailer. The study will examine various pricing scenarios, including single- and two-stage pricing system models that take into account the use of digital technologies. The market demand is based on retail price, freshness of product and Blockchain implementation effort. Our model is formulated under three different strategies-centralized, decentralized and revenue-cost sharing contract considering Big data technology. A Stackelberg game plan is also considered under the decentralized scheme, where the manufacturer is the leader and the retailer and distributor are the followers. The findings demonstrate that a number of variables, including the initial product quality level, the rate of deterioration, the cost optimization coefficient, and the cost of each supply chain member?s per unit of technology adoption affect each party?s profitability. Big data and Blockchain technology lead to enhanced profitability for both individual stakeholders and the overall supply chain. This adoption ensures a mutually beneficial scenario where all parties involved experience gains, resulting in a win-win situation. Further, we have explored the influence of key parameters on our model under various strategic scenarios. The outcomes of this research can be used by the academicians and practitioners to implement the best strategy in a perishable food supply chain with the help of digital technology.

judul: Innovative supply chain network design with two-step authentication and environmentally-friendly blockchain technology
authors: Babaei, Ardavan; Tirkolaee, Erfan Babaee; Ali, Sadia Samar
abstrak: Blockchain Technology (BT) has the potential to revolutionize supply chain management by providing transparency, but it also poses significant environmental and security challenges. BT consumes energy and emits carbon gases, affecting its adoption in Supply Chains (SCs). The substantial energy demand of blockchain networks contributes to carbon emissions and sustainability risks. Moreover, for secure and reliable transactions, mutual authentication needs to be established to address security concerns raised by SC managers. This paper proposes a tri-objective optimization model for the simultaneous design of the SC-BT network, considering a two-step authentication process. The model considers transparency caused by BT members, emissions of BT, and costs related to BT and SC design. It also takes into account uncertainty conditions for participating BT members in the SC and the range of transparency, cost, and emission targets. To solve the model, a Branch and Efficiency (B&E) algorithm equipped with BT-related criteria is developed. The algorithm is implemented in a three-level SC and produces cost-effective and environmentally friendly outcomes. However, the adoption of BT in the SC can be costly and harmful to the environment under uncertain conditions. It is worth mentioning that implementing the proposed algorithm from our article in a three-level SC case study can result in a significant cost reduction of over 16% and an emission reduction of over 13%. The iterative nature of this algorithm plays a vital role in achieving these positive outcomes.
