judul: Transforming insurance: A framework for decentralized models powered by insurtech
authors: Shoukat, Shahzad
abstrak: Historically, the insurance industry has relied on centralized operational models that pool risk but often suffer from structural inefficiencies. Today, the sector faces a turning point driven by technological innovation. Blockchain technology?characterized by decentralization, transparency, and immutability?offers a practical solution to long-standing problems like high administrative overhead, opaque policy terms, and information asymmetry. This paper develops a four-layer conceptual framework to map the transition from traditional insurance to decentralized, insurtech-driven alternatives, grounding this shift theoretically in Transaction Cost Economics and Agency Theory. We examine how foundational technologies such as blockchain, smart contracts, artificial intelligence (AI), and the Internet of Things (IoT) enable new structural approaches, including Peer-to-Peer (P2P), parametric, and Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) models. To move beyond purely conceptual discussions, this study uses a structured narrative review and comparative case study methodology, grounding the analysis in quantitative market indicators. By evaluating active platforms like InsurAce, Etherisc, Nexus Mutual, and the B3i consortium, the research demonstrates where decentralized systems succeed in cutting costs and improving trust, while also detailing where they fail. Widespread adoption still faces serious hurdles, from regulatory ambiguity and smart contract vulnerabilities to the actuarial challenge of basis risk in data oracles. Finally, the paper outlines an implementation roadmap for both incumbent insurers and regulators, proposing a future research agenda with specific, measurable criteria. By bridging technological capabilities with economic and organizational theory, this work offers a structured view of how insurance might evolve into a more accessible and efficient system.

judul: Smart contract vulnerability detection using opcode sequences with variable length
authors: Li, Peiqiang; Wang, Guojun; Liu, Xuelei; Chen, Mingfei; Zhu, Jinyao; Zhang, Yuheng
abstrak: Smart contracts represent a cornerstone of blockchain technology, enabling key applications in cryptocurrencies and decentralized finance (DeFi). Nevertheless, the inherent complexity in developing smart contracts frequently introduces severe security vulnerabilities. Compounding this issue, smart contracts become immutable upon deployment, exposing users and participants to substantial financial losses and risks. Consequently, vulnerability detection and security auditing emerge as imperative tasks. Existing deep learning-based vulnerability detection approaches are constrained to fixed-length input sequences, offering no effective mechanism for handling the variable-length opcode sequences derived from transaction executions. This limitation often results in data truncation, which compromises detection accuracy by discarding critical information. To overcome this challenge, a novel neural network model is proposed that accommodates variable-length input sequences. Opcode sequences are acquired through transaction replay as the dataset. Variable-length opcode sequences are processed using the ChordMixer architecture to preserve complete sequence information and extract global features. Additionally, a retention mechanism is integrated into the network to identify salient local features. This combined emphasis on global and local sequence information facilitates more precise security analysis and vulnerability prediction in smart contracts. Extensive experimental validation confirms the model?s efficacy, attaining 93.5% accuracy and 90.6% F1-score across seven vulnerability types. The approach advances the state-of-the-art by enabling truncation-free processing of long sequences, demonstrating superior performance over baselines reliant on fixed inputs.

judul: An Experimental Study on Human Nail Based Disease Detection and Image Retrieval Blockchain Framework
authors: Yadav, Abhay Kumar; Vishwakarma, Virendra P.
abstrak: The management of medical images remains a challenge for researchers globally, as images occupy large storage and are prone to cyber-attacks. Human nails serve as biological indicators predictinging the presence of several diseases. However, their real-world deployment is limited due to the time-consuming diagnostic methods and absence of secured data storage framework. This paper presents an experimental study of nail disease detection system using image processing technique, machine learning approach and blockchain technology for secure storage. The framework combines GrabCut segmentation, Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix feature extraction, DenseNet-201 deep learning classification, SHA-256 encryption, and Eigen Vector Decomposition-based image compression with Ethereum blockchain storage. The integrated framework offers enhanced multi-class nail disease classification and a secure, auditable and tamper-proof image management system on the blockchain, offering a viable pathway for Electronic Health Record and Internet of Medical Things integration.

judul: Multi-party transaction optimization decision-making in microgrid electricity market based on blockchain Berge-NS equilibrium
authors: Mo, Pingyan; Li, Kai; Hu, Xin; Lu, Yanqian; Wen, You
abstrak: A multi-agent transaction optimization decision-making method based on blockchain Berge-NS equilibrium is proposed, aiming to protect user interests and achieve carbon reduction objectives. Firstly, by improving the utility function of electricity users and quantifying the impact of blockchain technology on the electricity utility of market entities, a blockchain based P2P electricity trading architecture for microgrids is constructed, and a blockchain network and utility function for electricity users are designed; Secondly, the Evolutionary Game Theory based on bounded rationality decision-making is introduced to construct a Berge-NS game model on both sides of electricity supply and demand. The distributed iterative algorithm and step size control method are used to solve the Nash equilibrium, and the strategy evolution of demand side subjects in the game process is studied through dynamic processes; Finally, numerical simulations were conducted to analyze the trading strategies of bilateral contract markets, centralized trading markets, and dual layer decision-making models for electricity sellers, verifying the feasibility and effectiveness of the models and algorithms. The experimental results show that the proposed multi-agent trading Berge-NS decision-making method for microgrid electricity market exhibits certain performance advantages in reducing carbon emissions, lowering user electricity costs, and improving user satisfaction.

judul: Post quantum blockchain framework using probabilistic hidden state deep learning for smart IoT systems
authors: Keshavamurthy, T. G.; Guruprasad, S.; Hareesh, K. N.; Murthy, M. V. Chidananda; Ashwini, K. J.; Swathi, K. S.
abstrak: In recent years, smart IoT systems pose significant challenges regarding security, scalability, and intelligent decision-making for IoT data, particularly amid advances in quantum computing attacks. Traditional cryptographic and machine learning techniques seem insufficient for real-time IoT systems where data is dynamic and large-scale and security requirements are strict. In this paper, a novel Post-Quantum Probabilistic Hidden-State Deep Learning (PQP_HS_DL) framework is presented that comprises of effective probabilistic hidden state modelling, lattice-based post-quantum cryptography and blockchain technology to process IoT data securely and efficiently. In the proposed PQP_HS_DL framework, a probabilistic hidden state model is applied to learn temporal dynamics and uncertainty in IoT data streams to provide enhanced prediction and reliable anomaly detection capabilities. A lattice-based cryptographic scheme ensures quantum-resistant security, and blockchain provides data integrity, transparency, and decentralized trusted authority management. The system is further enhanced by edge computing to alleviate latency and realize real-time processing performance. The experimental evaluation of the proposed framework is carried out under 100 IoT nodes to evaluate its performance. The results of the PQP_HS_DL provide a high classification accuracy (97.6%), and higher precision, recall, and F1-score compared to the existing techniques. The latency (72 ms) is lower, the throughput (285 transactions per second) is higher, and energy consumption (0.91) is also effective in the PQP_HS_DL framework for real-time applications of IoT. Security analysis shows that the entropy (0.98) is very high, and the attack probability (0.01) is very low. The framework uses lattice-based post-quantum cryptographic mechanisms, which are effective against any classical attacker as well as against existing quantum cryptanalytic methods, based on standard computational assumptions. Scalability analysis demonstrates that the proposed framework, evaluated with run on IoT networks with over 1000 nodes, exhibits significant performance.

judul: A systematic literature review of ethical concerns in blockchain technology: towards a values-driven framework
authors: Motea, Mosa; Oba, Pius
abstrak: Blockchain technologies are increasingly applied in areas such as digital identity, healthcare, public governance, and smart-city services, where design and governance entail significant ethical and societal implications. Despite growing scholarly attention, the literature on blockchain ethics remains fragmented, unevenly prioritised, and weakly connected to practical system design and governance. This study addresses this gap through a systematic literature review examining how ethical values, theoretical frameworks, and methodological approaches are conceptualised and applied. Using a PRISMA-guided review of Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore, 1,051 records were screened, resulting in 91 peer-reviewed studies published between January 2014 and April 2025. Findings indicate that ethical focus is concentrated on privacy, transparency, security, and decentralisation, while fairness, inclusivity, communal accountability, and environmental responsibility receive limited attention. The literature is further characterised by predominant conceptual analysis, limited empirical evidence, inconsistent use of formal ethical or design frameworks, and fragmentation across application domains. These patterns reveal a persistent principle-practice gap, where ethical commitments are articulated but seldom translated into design requirements, governance mechanisms, or accountability structures. In response, the study proposes a values-driven ethical framework integrating ethical values, design principles, and governance mechanisms to support more context-sensitive and accountable blockchain systems. It further recommends embedding ethical impact assessments, participatory oversight, accountability and redress mechanisms, and context-sensitive implementation requirements into blockchain policy, procurement, and deployment processes.

judul: A behavior-based trust-gating framework for securing permissioned IoT blockchains using proof of authority
authors: N. A., Natraj; T., Abirami; M., Bhuvaneswari
abstrak: The integration of blockchain technology into Internet of Things (IoT) environments presents a fundamental conflict between the demand for robust, decentralized security and the severe computational constraints of IoT devices. While Proof-of-Authority (PoA) has emerged as an efficient consensus mechanism for permissioned networks, its inherent security model remains vulnerable to valid transactions from compromised or malicious nodes, a critical gap in existing protocols. This paper introduces PoA-TG Chain, a novel framework that enhances PoA with an integrated, lightweight Trust-Gating (PoA-TG) mechanism. This system assigns a dynamic, behavior-based trust score to each node, using it as a rapid pre-filter to reject transactions from untrusted actors before they enter the consensus process. Through a comprehensive simulation study, we conducted a rigorous comparative analysis of a standard PoA model against our proposed PoA-TG framework. The findings are definitive: the PoA-TG Chain framework reduced the success rate of malicious transactions from 25.35% in the standard PoA model to a mere 0.28%. This constitutes a 98.9% reduction in the remaining vulnerability, demonstrating the profound effectiveness of the trust-gating mechanism. This critical security hardening is achieved with remarkable efficiency, incurring only a 7.2% reduction in network throughput and a marginal 0.02% increase in average CPU load per transaction. Our work demonstrates that a dynamic, reputation-based security layer can provide near-total protection against the modeled threats at negligible performance cost, offering a viable, highly effective solution for securing resource-constrained IoT deployments.

judul: Blockchain-Based Decentralized Intrusion Detection System (B-DIDS) for enhancing malware detection in distributed networks
authors: Kumar, Mukesh; Joshi, Pooja; Bhatt, Ashutosh; Kumar, Sunil; Alsekait, Deema Mohammed; AbdElminaam, Diaa Salama
abstrak: The increase in the complexity of the distributed networks along with the rise in the threat of sophisticated malware attacks expect an innovative and robust solutions for intrusion detection. In this work, a novel Blockchain-Based Decentralized Intrusion Detection System (B-DIDS) is proposed for enhancing the malware detection paradigm in the distributed networks. Unlike the traditional intrusion detection systems, the proposed B-DIDS system leverages the inherent advantages of blockchain technology by including some of the additional features like the immutability, decentralization in addition with the transparency for addressing the challenges imposed by the centralized solutions like single points of failure and its limited scalability. The framework integrates the blockchain technology in addition with the hybrid machine learning algorithm (ILSTM), for identifying and mitigating the malware threats in real time. The ILSTM algorithm utilizes Isolation Forest (IF) algorithm in addition with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The IF algorithm isolates the anomalies by randomly selecting the features by splitting the data until all the points got isolated and the LSTM is used for capturing the complex patterns in the time series data which is helpful for identifying the anomalies. The smart contracts are employed for automating the consensus process inorder to verify the network anomalies by ensuring the durability and tamper proof responses for malicious activities. Also the system adopts a hybrid consensus mechanism by combining the Proof of Authority (PoA) and the Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT) for achieving the low latency detection and energy efficiency. The experiment is conducted based on simulated environment shows that the proposed algorithm achieves better detection accuracy in addition with better resilience against the sophisticated cyberattacks when compared to the existing systems. The proposed system also ensures the secure exchange of the intrusion data among the various nodes by fostering the collaborative approaches for threat intelligence when gets preserved with data privacy. In this research the potential of the blockchain based architecture is highlighted as a transformative solution for the next generation intrusion detection systems by paving the way for more secure and the reliable distributed networks.

judul: Multi-agent reinforcement integrated with blockchain: developing intrusion detection for IoT network security
authors: Zakariah, Mohammed; Alrayes, Fatma S.; Alzaylaee, Mohammed K.; Amin, Syed Umar; Khan, Zafar Iqbal
abstrak: The complexity of network security has grown, and new problems have emerged that call for more sophisticated network security solutions. Due to their historical reputation as rigid and unscalable systems, intrusion detection systems (IDSs) require innovation. This research proposes a distributed intrusion detection framework that integrates blockchain technology with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) for enhanced blockchain security, transparency, and decentralization. The proposed system was trained and tested over the Open, Public, and Network Traffic Dataset of Internet of Things (TON-IoT) to detect cyber threats in a resilient manner over IoT networks. Blockchain guarantees the integrity of data, while the IDS is MARL, which can learn active, unprecedented, and evolving attack patterns. Experiments have shown that the proposed approach achieves 99.99% accuracy on the TON-IoT dataset, outperforming standard IDS approaches. Further, the usage of the framework is validated for generalization by comparing the datasets of the Botnet Dataset for Internet of Things (BOT-IoT) dataset with 99.65% accuracy. To improve performance, a large ablation experiment was conducted to attempt to identify the required learning parameters (reward form, exploration-exploitation dilemma, and learning rate decay). To reduce the false positives, a balanced performance reward scheme was introduced, reducing the accuracy to 95.67%. For stable decision-making, the investigation rate was set to a constant 0.1. In experiments on learning information, we demonstrate that 0.001 is a reasonable compromise between convergence rate and stability. This is well exemplified by the fact that IDS can secure both systems by using MARL and Blockchain. Future work will then focus on real-time dynamicity, reducing computational overhead, and expanding the model to various network environments. This research establishes an emerging practice of intelligent distributed intrusion detection in emerging cybersecurity architectures.
